subject: Capability Fabric modular HAND and SKILL kinds v1

closedGaps.priorState: Capability Fabric compiled executable capability candidates but did not bind HAND or SKILL as a first-class recipe, plan, package, manifest, receipt, and verifier identity.
closedGaps.route: Extend the closed recipe and package contracts with exact kind-dependent runtime and portable-form rules.
closedGaps.result: HAND now requires an executable capability.js entry; SKILL requires the exact portable SKILL.md, skill.contract.json, and skill.selftest.js set with an explicit runtime mode and host boundary.

closedGaps.priorState: The Recipe Foundry had no concrete portable SKILL contribution proving its inactive authoring route.
closedGaps.route: Add one bounded host-mediated review-procedure skill pilot and keep it outside active builders and recipes.
closedGaps.result: The deterministic eight-file review packet contains a modular contract and a builder for the exact three-file portable skill; explicit trusted-host tests accept it through Capability Fabric's artifact contract.

closedGaps.priorState: A generic package could have relabelled its runtime, portable form, or kind after review while preserving a self-consistent digest graph.
closedGaps.route: Bind modular semantics at every identity seam and adversarially rehash altered packets.
closedGaps.result: Kind, runtime, portable form, operation, host requirements, and false authority are cross-checked; runtime and authority drift are refused after rehashing.

remainingGaps.reason: The active catalog intentionally remains three reviewed HAND recipes. No SKILL recipe or builder was activated by this work.
Mike's source review, merge decision, and any later activation remain outside both fabrics.
Closed contracts and two pilots cannot prove arbitrary future HAND or SKILL builder behavior, usefulness, safety, or visual fitness.
